description: Fix the d3d11.dll proxy DLL to be ultra-lightweight at load time with zero external dependencies, implement proper Present hook via dummy SwapChain from D3D11CreateDevice, and lazy-load all heavy modules. This addresses all three root causes of the GW2 'Unable to initialize 3D output' error.
steps: STEP 1 - Separate OCR engine into its own DLL (bronco_ocr.dll): Create src/ocr/CMakeLists.txt that builds a separate shared library 'bronco_ocr' linking against Tesseract::libtesseract and unofficial::sqlite3::sqlite3. This DLL exports a C API (bronco_ocr_create, bronco_ocr_initialize, bronco_ocr_recognize, bronco_ocr_shutdown, bronco_ocr_destroy). Keep src/ocr/ocr_engine.h and ocr_engine.cpp but add a new src/ocr/ocr_exports.h with the C API declarations and src/ocr/ocr_exports.cpp with implementations that delegate to OcrEngine. Add src/ocr/ocr_exports.def for the exports.

STEP 2 - Create a dynamic loader for the OCR DLL: Create src/ocr/ocr_loader.h and src/ocr/ocr_loader.cpp that uses LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress to load bronco_ocr.dll at runtime. This provides the same interface as OcrEngine but loads the DLL lazily on first use. The pipeline will use this loader instead of directly including tesseract headers.

STEP 3 - Modify src/CMakeLists.txt: Remove Tesseract::libtesseract from the main d3d11 target's link libraries. Remove ocr_engine.cpp from the main target's sources. Add ocr_loader.cpp instead. Keep imgui::imgui (it is header-only + small compiled backend, needed for overlay). Keep nlohmann_json (header-only). Keep unofficial::sqlite3::sqlite3 only in the OCR DLL, remove from main target. The main d3d11.dll should only link: imgui::imgui, nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json, d3d11.lib, dxgi.lib, d3dcompiler.lib. Update root CMakeLists.txt to add_subdirectory(src/ocr) before add_subdirectory(src) so the OCR DLL builds first.

STEP 4 - Modify src/pipeline/pipeline.cpp: Replace #include of ocr_engine.h with ocr_loader.h. Change the pipeline worker to use the OcrLoader interface instead of directly calling OcrEngine methods. The loader handles LoadLibrary of bronco_ocr.dll on first call.

STEP 5 - Fix the Present hook to work with D3D11CreateDevice (without SwapChain): Modify src/proxy/d3d11_proxy.cpp's proxied_D3D11CreateDevice function. After successfully calling the real D3D11CreateDevice, if the hook has not yet been installed (check a global atomic flag), create a hidden dummy HWND, query IDXGIDevice -> IDXGIAdapter -> IDXGIFactory from the returned ID3D11Device, then call factory->CreateSwapChain with a minimal DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC pointing to the dummy window. Use this temporary swap chain to get the VTable pointer for IDXGISwapChain, then call hook::hookSwapChain(tempSwapChain). Release the temp swap chain and destroy the dummy window. This patches Present/ResizeBuffers globally since all swap chains share the same VTable. Keep the existing hook in proxied_D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain as a fallback.

STEP 6 - Make DllMain minimal: Modify src/dllmain.cpp to ONLY call proxy::initialize() in DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH. Remove the call to hook::install() from DllMain. The hook::install() is currently a no-op (just sets a flag) but remove it for clarity - the hook will be installed from proxied_D3D11CreateDevice instead.

STEP 7 - Update src/hook/present_hook.h and present_hook.cpp: Remove the install() function (it was just setting a flag). Keep uninstall() and hookSwapChain(). Add a guard in hookSwapChain so it only hooks once (already exists via the g_originalPresent check). Remove the g_hookInstalled atomic since it served no real purpose.

STEP 8 - Update the CI workflow (.github/workflows/build-release.yml): In the 'Package release' step, also copy the bronco_ocr.dll to the release directory alongside d3d11.dll. Search for it in build/release similar to how d3d11.dll is found.
STEP 9 - Update docs/INSTALL.md and scripts: Mention that bronco_ocr.dll must be in the same folder as d3d11.dll. Update install.ps1 to copy both DLLs.

STEP 10 - Ensure the translation module (dictionary.cpp, translator.cpp) is part of the OCR DLL or loaded lazily: Since translator.cpp uses dictionary.cpp which uses sqlite3 and the LRU cache, and it's called from the pipeline worker thread, move translator.cpp and dictionary.cpp into the bronco_ocr DLL as well (they are only used in the OCR processing context). Update the C API to include translation functions (bronco_ocr_translate_batch) or keep them internal to the OCR DLL called via a combined 'process frame' C API function.
acceptance_criteria: The main d3d11.dll target in CMakeLists.txt does NOT link against Tesseract, leptonica, sqlite3, or any other heavy dependency - only system DLLs (d3d11.lib, dxgi.lib, d3dcompiler.lib) and header-only/lightweight libs (imgui, nlohmann_json)
A separate bronco_ocr.dll (or similar) is built that contains the OCR engine, translation, and dictionary code with all heavy dependencies
The main d3d11.dll loads bronco_ocr.dll via LoadLibrary at runtime (not at DLL load time) only when the pipeline needs OCR
proxied_D3D11CreateDevice creates a dummy swap chain to obtain the VTable and hooks Present/ResizeBuffers globally, so GW2's D3D11CreateDevice path triggers the hook
DllMain only calls proxy::initialize() to load the real d3d11.dll and resolve the 3 main function pointers + forwarded exports
All source files are internally consistent - no missing includes, no references to removed functions, .def exports match declared extern C functions
The CI workflow packages bronco_ocr.dll alongside d3d11.dll in the release ZIP
verification: Run 'cmake -P /dev/null' style check or manually review CMakeLists.txt for syntax correctness
Verify that src/CMakeLists.txt does not list Tesseract::libtesseract in the d3d11 target's target_link_libraries
Verify proxied_D3D11CreateDevice in d3d11_proxy.cpp contains the dummy-swapchain hook logic
Verify DllMain in dllmain.cpp only calls proxy::initialize() and nothing else on attach
Verify the .def file exports still match the extern C function declarations
Review the OCR DLL's C API for completeness
findings: All 10 steps implemented. Cannot build on Linux host (MSVC + vcpkg required), so validation was done via code structure review, CMake syntax checking, and consistency verification (.def exports match declarations, no dangling references to removed functions, include paths are correct). Key design: ocr_engine.h is a lightweight header (no Tesseract includes) so it can still be included by config.h in the main DLL for the ScreenRegion type. The heavy implementation (ocr_engine.cpp, translator.cpp, dictionary.cpp) lives exclusively in bronco_ocr.dll. Post-review fixes applied: (1) g_presentHooked now set in CreateDeviceAndSwapChain path, (2) RegisterClassExW tolerates ERROR_CLASS_ALREADY_EXISTS, (3) OcrLoader resolves bronco_ocr.dll path relative to proxy DLL location via GetModuleFileNameW, (4) uninstall.ps1 removes bronco_ocr.dll.
